vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Track customer originals and collection records without losing the link to each order.
requirements.zh: 跟踪客户原件及领取记录，保持与各订单的关联。

requirements.en: Scan using supplied specifications and check file completeness, orientation and names.
requirements.zh: 按提供的规格扫描，并检查文件完整性、方向及名称。

requirements.en: Maintain clear review queues and handovers for damaged originals and unfinished work.
requirements.zh: 为损坏原件及未完成工作维护清晰的审核队列及交接。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently calibrate displays and manage production colour profiles.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立校准显示器，并管理生产色彩配置文件。
